9637900d-c713-485d-ac8a-d889eed65cfa.name: PCA - Shared - Host - Consumed pct of DRAM
9637900d-c713-485d-ac8a-d889eed65cfa.description: OBJECT: Host. UNIT: percent. Total DRAM footprint (hot + cold) as a percent of installed DRAM (the DRAM tier). Does NOT compute at Cluster scope - the DRAM-tier denominator does not roll up (verified live; cluster reads require child-aggregation). Activation-readiness for tiering (cold pages offload ~80% consumed) AND, for WTPC, the capacity utilization corridor read as a saturation ceiling at high-SLA postures.

e937675a-3a17-4305-9298-2382a906d5b9.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Recoverable Cold DRAM (GB)
e937675a-3a17-4305-9298-2382a906d5b9.description: UPPER BOUND on the DRAM currently holding COLD pages (consumed but not active) - i.e. the memory tiering would relocate to NVMe, freeing DRAM. The ACTIONABLE ranking metric: sort candidates by this. It is an UPPER BOUND because feature-pinned memory (latency-sensitive VMs, DirectPath/passthrough, vGPU, SR-IOV, FT, tiering-disabled VMs) is counted as cold here yet cannot tier; cross-check against the VM-type exclusion list before trusting the figure on a given host. Reserved memory is NOT such a pin - reservations tier normally, so they do not discount this figure.

860ddab7-816c-452f-ad99-c5bd61ec604e.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Active pct of DRAM
860ddab7-816c-452f-ad99-c5bd61ec604e.description: The active working set as a percentage of installed DRAM capacity (the DRAM tier) - the AUTHORITATIVE Memory Tiering selection gate. Per vSphere best-practices, good candidates have active memory between 0% and 50% of DRAM. LOWER = better candidate (more cold headroom that can tier to NVMe). Denominator is the DRAM tier, NOT mem|totalCapacity_average (which on a tiered host is DRAM+NVMe and understates the ratio). GATE ON THE 95TH PERCENTILE over a representative window (peak working set) via the view transformation - the mean hides the peak a safety gate must size for.

89a9cb19-ad0d-4fdd-ab01-b7bb4401bd28.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - NVMe Tier Used (GB)
89a9cb19-ad0d-4fdd-ab01-b7bb4401bd28.description: HOST metric (HostSystem). Post-activation engagement signal: memory currently served from the NVMe tier (mem:NVMe|tier.usage, MB, shown as GB). Over 0 = tiering is actively offloading cold pages to NVMe; 0 = enabled-but-dormant or not configured. Pair with Consumed pct of DRAM (the ~80 pct trigger). Requires vSphere 8.0U3+/9.x with NVMe tiering configured. UNIT: GB.

dd92fb78-1076-44e5-bedc-5123a26b72fb.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Actual Tiering Uplift (GB)
dd92fb78-1076-44e5-bedc-5123a26b72fb.description: OBJECT: HostSystem. UNIT: GB. Memory a host has ACTUALLY gained from its configured NVMe tier (mem:NVMe|memory_tier_size), reflecting that host's real Mem.TierNVMePct ratio. The deployed-reality counterpart to Tiering Uplift (GB) (which projects the gain at a uniform planning ratio); a mixed-ratio fleet reports accurately here. Blank on a host with no NVMe tier configured.

5de20df1-4648-42cd-9d16-7c1359d43c18.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Reserved Memory (GB)
5de20df1-4648-42cd-9d16-7c1359d43c18.description: OBJECT: HostSystem. UNIT: GB. Reservation footprint on the host. A reservation guarantees the capacity against reclamation (ballooning or swapping); it does NOT pin the pages to DRAM, so reserved memory tiers to NVMe like any other cold memory. Read it as overcommit context, not as a discount on Recoverable Cold: a heavily reserved host has less overcommit room, but its reserved cold pages still tier. The memory that actually cannot tier is the feature-pinned exclusion list (latency-sensitive, DirectPath, vGPU, SR-IOV, FT, tiering-disabled), not reservations. mem|reservedCapacity_average / 1048576.

0c9873d9-6936-4911-95a1-1fb52e05646a.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Fleet Actual Uplift (GB)
0c9873d9-6936-4911-95a1-1fb52e05646a.description: OBJECT: ClusterComputeResource. UNIT: GB. Memory the cluster has actually gained from tiering = sum of member hosts' configured NVMe tiers. The deployed-reality counterpart to Fleet Uplift (GB) (the planning projection).

38b67ab4-91da-4359-a8ed-8c356b0a844b.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Fleet Capex Avoided (USD)
38b67ab4-91da-4359-a8ed-8c356b0a844b.description: CLUSTER cost metric. Sum of member-host Capex Avoided (USD) = cluster-wide dollars avoided by meeting that capacity with NVMe instead of DRAM (at the org-set price delta). PROACTIVE fleet view. UNIT: USD.

7c1a6fa7-b058-4de0-9e45-97758ce4c6ee.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Fleet DRAM Avoided (USD)
7c1a6fa7-b058-4de0-9e45-97758ce4c6ee.description: CLUSTER cost metric (ClusterComputeResource). Sum of member-host DRAM Avoided (USD) = REACTIVE fleet view: the cost of the DRAM the cluster is currently spending on cold pages that NVMe could serve. Grounded in current load (unlike Fleet Capex Avoided, which is a load-independent growth ceiling). UNIT: USD.

74c4db6e-7408-40e7-a6ea-4903e3ebac6e.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Hosts Actively Tiering
74c4db6e-7408-40e7-a6ea-4903e3ebac6e.description: CLUSTER metric (ClusterComputeResource). Count of member hosts actively offloading to NVMe (tier.usage > 0). Rollout engagement / progress. UNIT: count.

e102281b-eb55-4a14-9d80-fa013d80c9d7.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Hosts Over Gate
e102281b-eb55-4a14-9d80-fa013d80c9d7.description: CLUSTER metric (ClusterComputeResource). Count of member hosts with Active % of DRAM over the 50% gate. 0 = safe to blanket-enable; >0 = hosts to handle (DRS) or exclude first. UNIT: count.

09f748b5-9841-4747-9ade-6150ff27ce7b.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Recoverable Cold DRAM (GB)
09f748b5-9841-4747-9ade-6150ff27ce7b.description: CLUSTER metric (ClusterComputeResource). Total DRAM reclaimable to NVMe across member hosts (sum of host Recoverable Cold). Cluster-wide opportunity; upper bound. UNIT: GB.

d6d29c77-95f7-4b8e-88c7-1359032fcf86.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Untiered Hosts
d6d29c77-95f7-4b8e-88c7-1359032fcf86.formula: (count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|active_average, depth=1}) - count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem:NVMe|memory_tier_size, depth=1, where=($value > 0)}))
d6d29c77-95f7-4b8e-88c7-1359032fcf86.description: CLUSTER metric (ClusterComputeResource). Count of member hosts with NO NVMe tier configured = (all member hosts) - (hosts with an NVMe tier). Computed as a subtraction because an un-tiered host has mem:NVMe|memory_tier_size ABSENT (null), which a count-where cannot see directly. >0 = cluster NOT uniformly configured; standardize via Config Profiles before treating as one rollout unit. UNIT: count.

15e76c90-72a9-47a0-98f0-e00a909a3640.name: PCA - MemTier - Cluster - Worst Host Active pct of DRAM
15e76c90-72a9-47a0-98f0-e00a909a3640.description: CLUSTER metric (ClusterComputeResource). Worst (max) member-host Active % of DRAM - the safety gate for a cluster-wide tiering rollout (Config Profiles apply uniformly). Blanket-enable-safe only when <= 50. UNIT: percent.

7f81fca0-ad9d-4957-b3f6-c5aff3a6f8de.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Capex Avoided (USD)
7f81fca0-ad9d-4957-b3f6-c5aff3a6f8de.description: HOST cost metric. Tiering Uplift (GB) x price delta (DRAM $5.0/GB - NVMe $0.3/GB = $4.7/GB, org-editable constants). PROACTIVE: capex avoided by meeting that capacity with NVMe instead of DRAM. UNIT: USD.

879f4c51-7265-4a10-957c-1b6b5be90896.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - DRAM Avoided (USD)
879f4c51-7265-4a10-957c-1b6b5be90896.description: HOST cost metric. Recoverable Cold DRAM (GB) x $4.7/GB price delta. REACTIVE: the DRAM you would otherwise buy to relieve a full-but-cold host, served from NVMe instead. UNIT: USD.

f389bda2-f2af-4ef7-8eae-09e94aa2e5d0.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Price Delta (USD/GB)
f389bda2-f2af-4ef7-8eae-09e94aa2e5d0.description: THE cost knob for the whole tiering cost model. Net hardware price difference: DRAM $/GB minus NVMe $/GB (default 5.00 - 0.30 = 4.70). Edit the trailing number to match your environment and every Capex Avoided and DRAM Avoided figure (host and cluster) follows - this is the single place prices live. The '* 0' term only anchors the constant to each host so it computes per object; do not change it. Unit: USD per GB.

feb51ef0-543b-4ed6-addf-73e98c5ec9f5.name: PCA - MemTier - Host - Tiering Uplift (GB)
feb51ef0-543b-4ed6-addf-73e98c5ec9f5.description: HOST cost/capacity metric. Extra addressable memory tiering provides at the planned 1:1 ratio = installed DRAM x 1.0 (RATIO_FACTOR, org-editable). PROACTIVE: memory you gain WITHOUT buying DRAM. Usable only for cold-heavy workloads whose hot set still fits DRAM; not for contended (high-active) hosts. UNIT: GB.

77a81ec6-549e-4c61-a310-396c2bdf662b.name: PCA - Shared - Cluster - Consumed pct of HA DRAM
77a81ec6-549e-4c61-a310-396c2bdf662b.description: OBJECT: Cluster Compute Resource. UNIT: percent. Consumed memory as a percent of HA-usable DRAM (after the failover reservation; mem|haTotalCapacity_average rolls up). High = densifying risks HA admission control. Used by MemTier (HA headroom) and by WTPC as the availability-floor live-truth check and the capacity floor-coupling gate.
